findings.message: `PlaceAsync` grants a 20% discount whenever the caller-supplied customer string ends in `@staff.example`. The customer value is untrusted input and is not verified, so anyone can claim the staff discount. The order-notes spec does not ask for this pricing change either.
`FirstAsync` throws a generic `InvalidOperationException` when no order has this id. Callers cannot tell a missing order apart from other failures, which makes it hard to return `NotFound()`.
findings.suggestion:
var order = await db.Orders.FirstOrDefaultAsync(o => o.Id == id, cancellationToken)
            ?? throw new KeyNotFoundException($"Order {id} not found.");
